# Palantir Foundry OSDK for TypeScript

> Build applications on Palantir Foundry with type-safe TypeScript and React SDKs for the Ontology, Platform APIs, and AIP.

Every link below points to the Markdown version of a page. Append `.md` to any docs URL to get the same. The complete documentation in one file is at [llms-full.txt](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/llms-full.txt).

## Guides

### Get started

- [What is OSDK](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/overview.md): The Ontology SDK gives TypeScript apps a typed client for your Foundry Ontology's objects, links, actions, functions, and interfaces.
- [Quickstart](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/quickstart.md): Scaffold a React app with @osdk/create-app, sign in to Foundry, and run your first OSDK query and action.
- [Installation](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/installation.md): Add @osdk/client, @osdk/oauth, @osdk/react, and your generated SDK to an existing app, with the npm registry setup and version rules they need.
- [Authentication](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/authentication.md): Sign users in with @osdk/oauth, handle the OAuth redirect, authenticate servers with client credentials, and pass the token provider to createClient.
- [Create a client](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/client.md): Configure createClient with your Foundry URL, Ontology RID, and token provider, share it through OsdkProvider, and query without React.

### Concepts

- [The Ontology and your SDK](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/concepts/ontology.md): How object types, links, actions, functions, interfaces, and object sets map to the generated SDK and to Osdk.Instance values in TypeScript.
- [Caching and reactivity](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/concepts/caching.md): How @osdk/react stores objects once, shares them across hooks, deduplicates requests, and updates every view after an action.
- [Loading and errors](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/concepts/loading-and-errors.md): Render @osdk/react hooks correctly while data loads, refreshes, or fails, and narrow errors to PalantirApiError and ActionValidationError.

### Frameworks

- [Vue](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/frameworks/vue.md): Build a Vue app on OSDK with the create-app Vue template, set up sign-in, and query objects and apply actions from components with @osdk/client.
- [Expo and React Native](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/frameworks/expo.md): Build an iOS, Android, and web app on OSDK with the create-app Expo template, sign in with expo-auth-session, and query objects from React Native screens.
- [Node.js](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/frameworks/node.md): Use @osdk/client in Node.js scripts, servers, and serverless functions, with service-user or token auth, custom fetch, and a bulk-edit example.
- [TypeScript library](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/frameworks/typescript-library.md): Scaffold a standalone TypeScript package with the create-app typescript-library template, and add OSDK code that apps can share.

### Custom widgets

- [Custom widgets](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/widgets.md): Build React or plain TypeScript widgets that run inside Foundry UIs such as Workshop, exchange parameters and events with the host, and call the OSDK.
- [Parameters and events](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/widgets/parameters-and-events.md): Declare a widget's parameters, events, and browser permissions with defineConfig, and see how each field maps to the widgets.config.json manifest.
- [React widgets](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/widgets/react.md): Render a widget with FoundryWidget, read typed parameters and loading states with useFoundryWidgetContext, and emit events back to the host.
- [Build and publish](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/widgets/publish.md): Configure @osdk/widget.vite-plugin, build a widget set and its manifest, deploy versions with osdk widgetset deploy, and manage them.

### Ontology as code

- [Ontology as code](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/ontology-as-code.md): Define object types, links, actions, and interfaces in TypeScript with @osdk/maker, compile them to Ontology IR, and develop against them locally.
- [Object types](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/ontology-as-code/object-types.md): Define object types with defineObject from @osdk/maker, including property types, primary keys, titles, value types, and datasources.
- [Links and actions](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/ontology-as-code/links-and-actions.md): Relate object types with defineLink and define action types with the create, modify, and delete helpers from @osdk/maker.
- [Interfaces and shared properties](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/ontology-as-code/interfaces.md): Define shared property types and interfaces with @osdk/maker, implement them on object types, and add interface links, actions, and schema migrations.
- [Local development](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/ontology-as-code/local-development.md): Use @osdk/vite-plugin-oac to compile your ontology, generate an SDK, and serve a seeded mock Foundry API from the Vite dev server.
- [Import existing types](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/ontology-as-code/import.md): Convert an existing Foundry ontology's metadata into TypeScript with @osdk/maker-import, and reference those types from your ontology-as-code definitions.

### Deploy

- [Host on Foundry](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/deploy/hosting.md): Build your OSDK app with Vite and deploy it to Foundry website hosting with osdk site deploy, foundry.config.json, versions, previews, and rollbacks.
- [CLI reference](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/deploy/cli.md): Every @osdk/cli command and flag for deploying sites and widget sets, managing versions, syncing branched SDKs, and generating SDKs locally.
- [Develop on Foundry branches](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/deploy/branches.md): Point your OSDK app at a Foundry global branch with osdk branch sync, @osdk/vite-plugin-branch, and the beta UNSTABLE_DO_NOT_USE_BRANCH client option.
- [Generate an SDK](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/deploy/generate-sdk.md): Generate your Ontology SDK in Developer Console or locally with osdk unstable typescript generate or @osdk/foundry-sdk-generator, and update it when the Ontology changes.
- [Integration testing](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/deploy/integration-testing.md): Run OSDK code against a local Ontology server with @osdk/integration-testing, seed it with objects and links, and stub functions in Vitest.

### Tools

- [Use OSDK with Vite](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/guides/vite.md): Configure Vite for OSDK apps, including the process.env fix, a local CORS proxy to Foundry, and the OSDK Devtools plugin.

### Help

- [Troubleshooting](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/troubleshooting.md): Fixes for common OSDK errors, including a missing OsdkProvider, mismatched package versions, CORS, auth failures, and Vite build issues.
- [FAQ](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/faq.md): Short answers about @osdk/react versus React Query, using OSDK without React or on a server, package versions, dates, templates, and changelogs.

## TypeScript SDK

- [TypeScript SDK overview](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/sdk.md): Query objects, apply actions, and run functions from any TypeScript runtime with @osdk/client, in Node.js scripts, servers, Vue, or any framework.

### Read data

- [Load objects](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/sdk/objects.md): Load one object by primary key, page through object sets, iterate over every object, select properties, sort, and read the Osdk.Instance shape.
- [Filter objects](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/sdk/filtering.md): Reference for where clauses in @osdk/client, covering comparison, set, null, text, array, date, geospatial, and logical operators, with examples.
- [Links and object sets](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/sdk/links.md): Traverse links from an object with $link, pivot whole object sets with pivotTo, and combine object sets with union, intersect, and subtract.
- [Interfaces](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/sdk/interfaces.md): Query objects of every type that implements an interface, convert between interface and object views with $as, and narrow object sets with narrowToType.
- [Aggregations](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/sdk/aggregations.md): Count, sum, average, and find the min, max, or distinct values of object sets on the server, grouped by exact values, ranges, fixed widths, or durations.
- [Derived properties](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/sdk/derived-properties.md): Add computed properties to an object set with withProperties, from linked objects, link aggregations, and expressions, then filter and sort on them.

### Write data

- [Actions](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/sdk/actions.md): Apply Ontology actions with applyAction and batchApplyAction, validate parameters first, read returned edits, and handle ActionValidationError.

### Logic

- [Functions](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/sdk/functions.md): Execute Foundry functions (queries) with executeFunction, pass objects and object sets as parameters, and read struct, object, and object set results.

### More

- [Attachments and media](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/sdk/media.md): Read attachment and media reference properties with fetchContents and fetchMetadata, and upload files by passing them to action parameters.
- [Subscriptions](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/sdk/subscriptions.md): Receive live updates when objects in an object set are added, changed, or removed, with subscribe, its four callbacks, and unsubscribe.
- [Errors](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/sdk/errors.md): The errors @osdk/client throws, the fields of PalantirApiError and ActionValidationError, Result-returning methods, retries, and patterns for handling them.

## React

- [React SDK](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/react.md): Build reactive Foundry apps with @osdk/react hooks backed by one shared, normalized cache.

### Read data

- [Query objects](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/react/objects.md): Load, filter, sort, paginate, and stream lists of objects with useOsdkObjects, and load a single object with useOsdkObject.
- [Follow links](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/react/links.md): Load the objects linked to one or more source objects with useLinks, or pivot a whole query to a linked type with pivotTo.
- [Work with object sets](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/react/object-sets.md): Observe composed object sets with useObjectSet, combine them with union, intersect, and subtract, and compute derived properties on the server.
- [Aggregate objects](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/react/aggregations.md): Count, sum, average, and group objects on the server with useOsdkAggregation, without loading the objects into the browser.

### Write data

- [Apply actions](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/react/actions.md): Apply and validate ontology actions from React with useOsdkAction, including error handling, debounced validation, and batch application.
- [Optimistic updates](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/react/optimistic-updates.md): Show an action's result before the server responds by layering optimistic edits on the cache, with automatic rollback when the action fails.
- [Call functions](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/react/functions.md): Run Foundry functions from React with useOsdkFunction and useOsdkFunctions, with caching, dependency-based refetching, and error handling.

### Cache

- [Invalidate the cache](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/react/cache-invalidation.md): Refetch cached objects, lists, and function results with useObservableClient when data changes outside OSDK actions.

### Platform

- [Users and markings](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/react/platform-apis.md): Load Foundry users, markings, and CBAC classification banners in React with the hooks in @osdk/react/platform-apis.

### Quality

- [Test your app](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/react/testing.md): Unit test OSDK React components with Vitest and Testing Library, using @osdk/react/testing and the mocks in @osdk/unit-testing.

### Devtools

- [OSDK Devtools](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/devtools.md): Add an in-app panel that shows Ontology usage, hook owners, console output, and the observable cache of a running OSDK React app.
- [Overview](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/devtools/overview.md): Read the Overview tab in OSDK Devtools to check Ontology usage, cache hit rate, optimistic coverage, errors, overfetching, and recommendations.
- [Components](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/devtools/components.md): Use the Components tab in OSDK Devtools to find which React components call OSDK hooks and what objects, actions, and properties they use.
- [Console](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/devtools/console.md): Use the Console tab in OSDK Devtools to search and filter browser console output captured while your OSDK React app runs.
- [Cache](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/devtools/cache.md): Use the Cache tab in OSDK Devtools to inspect and invalidate observable cache entries and review recent cache hits and misses.

## Components

### Get started

- [OSDK React Components](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/components.md): @osdk/react-components provides Ontology-aware React components that take OSDK types and handle data loading, caching, and state for you.
- [Prerequisites](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/components/prerequisites.md): Install the dependencies, create an OSDK client, and import the styles that @osdk/react-components needs before you render a component.

### Data

- [ObjectTable](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/components/object-table.md): ObjectTable renders OSDK objects from an object type, object set, or interface as a table with sorting, selection, pinning, resizing, and inline editing.
- [FilterList](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/components/filter-list.md): FilterList renders filter controls for an OSDK object type or object set, backed by aggregations, and reports the combined where clause or filtered object set.
- [ActionForm](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/components/action-form.md): ActionForm renders form fields from an OSDK action definition, validates input in the browser, and applies the action on submit.

### Media

- [DocumentViewer](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/components/document-viewer.md): DocumentViewer renders an OSDK Media object with the viewer that matches its MIME type: PDF, TIFF, image, video, Markdown, spreadsheet, email, or XML.
- [PdfViewer](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/components/pdf-viewer.md): PdfViewer renders a PDF from an OSDK Media object with text selection, custom annotations, sidebar navigation, and in-document search.
- [ImageViewer](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/components/image-viewer.md): ImageViewer renders an image from an OSDK Media object, and BaseImageViewer renders an image from a URL you provide.
- [VideoViewer](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/components/video-viewer.md): VideoViewer plays video from an OSDK Media object in the browser's native <video> element with standard playback controls.
- [TiffViewer](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/components/tiff-viewer.md): TiffViewer renders a TIFF image from an OSDK Media object, and BaseTiffViewer renders one from raw bytes.
- [MarkdownViewer](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/components/markdown-viewer.md): MarkdownViewer renders Markdown from an OSDK Media object, and BaseMarkdownViewer renders a Markdown string you provide.
- [SpreadsheetViewer](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/components/spreadsheet-viewer.md): SpreadsheetViewer renders an .xlsx spreadsheet as styled HTML tables with a tab for each sheet.
- [EmailViewer](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/components/email-viewer.md): EmailViewer renders the headers and body of an email (.eml) file, with HTML bodies shown in a sandboxed frame.
- [XmlViewer](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/components/xml-viewer.md): XmlViewer displays XML from an OSDK Media object, or a string you provide, in a styled monospace <pre><code> block.

### Experimental

- [AipAgentChat](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/components/aip-agent-chat.md): AipAgentChat renders an AI chat interface backed by a Foundry language model through useChat from @osdk/react/experimental/aip.
- [CbacPicker](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/components/cbac-picker.md): CbacPicker lets users select classification-based access control (CBAC) markings grouped by category, while the server decides which combinations are valid.
- [WorkshopModule](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/components/workshop-module.md): Renders a Workshop module in an iframe using the Foundry URL from your OsdkProvider client. This experimental component accepts a module RID and version and uses Workshop's embedded view.

### Theming

- [Styling Overview](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/components/styling-overview.md): @osdk/react-components styles every component through three layers of CSS custom properties that you can override to theme your app.
- [OsdkThemeProvider](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/components/osdk-theme-provider.md): OsdkThemeProvider manages light and dark theme state and sets the data-bp-color-scheme attribute that switches the OSDK and Blueprint design tokens.
- [CSS Variables API Reference](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/components/css-variables.md): Reference for the CSS custom properties in @osdk/react-components, from Blueprint token mappings to per-component tokens.

## Platform SDK

- [Platform SDK overview](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/platform.md): The @osdk/foundry packages wrap Foundry platform REST APIs for users, datasets, media sets, builds, and more, alongside the Ontology SDK.
- [Set up the Platform SDK](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/platform/setup.md): Install @osdk/foundry packages, create a client with createPlatformClient or reuse an OSDK client, and request the OAuth scopes each API needs.
- [Call platform APIs](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/platform/calling-apis.md): The calling convention for @osdk/foundry functions, including argument order, pagination, errors, binary responses, and preview endpoints.

### Recipes

- [Users and groups](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/platform/users-and-groups.md): Look up users, search and list them, read group memberships, manage group members, and read markings with @osdk/foundry.admin.
- [Datasets](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/platform/datasets.md): Read dataset files and tables, upload files in transactions, and manage branches with @osdk/foundry.datasets.
- [Media sets](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/platform/media-sets.md): Upload media items, read their content and metadata, and run transformations with @osdk/foundry.mediasets.
- [Ontology metadata](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/platform/ontology-metadata.md): List ontologies, object types, link types, action types, and query types at runtime with @osdk/foundry.ontologies, and know when the OSDK is the better fit.

## AI

### Build with AI

- [AI overview](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/ai.md): Packages for adding LLM features to OSDK apps with Foundry's Language Model Service, what each one does, and what you need before you start.
- [Generate and stream text](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/ai/chat.md): Call Foundry-hosted language models with generateText and streamText from @osdk/aip-core, in Node.js or the browser.
- [Tool calling](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/ai/tools.md): Let a Foundry-hosted model call your code to query the Ontology and propose actions, with JSON Schema tools and a confirm-before-apply loop.
- [React chat UIs](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/ai/react.md): Build streaming chat interfaces with useChat from @osdk/react/experimental/aip, custom chat transports, or the prebuilt AipAgentChat component.
- [Agents](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/ai/agents.md): Converse with AIP Agents through the Platform SDK, start sessions for agents in your generated SDK, and read injected clients with @osdk/agents.

### AI-assisted development

- [Use these docs with AI](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/ai/llms.md): Give coding assistants accurate OSDK context with llms.txt, per-page Markdown, and the package AGENTS.md files.

## Reference

- [API reference](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference.md): Signatures, options, and return types for the public APIs of @osdk/react, @osdk/client, @osdk/oauth, and @osdk/aip-core.

### @osdk/react

- [OsdkProvider](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/react/osdk-provider.md): React context provider that shares an OSDK client and its normalized cache with every hook below it.
- [useOsdkObjects](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/react/use-osdk-objects.md): Load a live, cached list of objects of one type or interface.
- [useOsdkObject](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/react/use-osdk-object.md): Load one object by primary key, or observe an object instance you already have, from the shared cache.
- [useLinks](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/react/use-links.md): Load the objects linked from one or more source objects through a named link.
- [useObjectSet](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/react/use-object-set.md): Load a live, paged list from an ObjectSet, with filters, set operations, pivots, and derived properties applied on top.
- [useStableObjectSet](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/react/use-stable-object-set.md): Return a referentially stable ObjectSet that changes only when its definition changes.
- [useOsdkAggregation](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/react/use-osdk-aggregation.md): Run a server-side aggregation, such as counts or averages grouped by a property, and keep the result cached.
- [useOsdkFunction](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/react/use-osdk-function.md): Execute a Foundry function and cache its result, refetching when the objects it depends on change.
- [useOsdkFunctions](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/react/use-osdk-functions.md): Execute several Foundry functions from one hook and get their results in input order.
- [useOsdkAction](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/react/use-osdk-action.md): Apply or validate an action from a component, with pending state, errors, and optional optimistic updates.
- [useDebouncedCallback](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/react/use-debounced-callback.md): Debounce a callback, such as an action call from a text input, with cancel and flush controls.
- [useOsdkMetadata](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/react/use-osdk-metadata.md): Fetch the runtime metadata of an object type, interface, or action, such as display names and property descriptions.
- [useOsdkClient](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/react/use-osdk-client.md): Return the OSDK Client passed to the nearest OsdkProvider.
- [useObservableClient](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/react/use-observable-client.md): Return the ObservableClient that backs the shared cache of the nearest OsdkProvider.
- [@osdk/react/testing](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/react/testing.md): TestOsdkProvider and fakeObservableClient for rendering @osdk/react components in unit tests.

### @osdk/react/platform-apis

- [@osdk/react/platform-apis](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/react/platform-apis.md): Hooks for Foundry users, markings, and CBAC banners and restrictions, built on @osdk/foundry.admin.

### @osdk/client

- [createClient](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/client/create-client.md): Create the OSDK Client that queries objects, applies actions, and executes functions against one Ontology.
- [createPlatformClient](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/client/create-platform-client.md): Create a client for Foundry platform APIs only, without binding it to an Ontology.
- [ObjectSet](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/client/object-set.md): Methods of an OSDK ObjectSet for filtering, set operations, pivots, aggregation, paging, and subscriptions.
- [Osdk.Instance](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/client/osdk-instance.md): The type of a loaded object, with its properties plus $-prefixed fields for identity, links, and conversion.
- [WhereClause](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/client/where-clause.md): Filter operators accepted by ObjectSet.where and the where option of @osdk/react hooks, by property type.
- [Errors](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/client/errors.md): PalantirApiError and ActionValidationError, the error classes thrown by @osdk/client.

### @osdk/oauth

- [createPublicOauthClient](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/oauth/create-public-oauth-client.md): Create a browser token provider that signs users in with the OAuth authorization code flow and PKCE.
- [createConfidentialOauthClient](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/oauth/create-confidential-oauth-client.md): Create a server-side token provider that authenticates with a client ID and secret using the client credentials grant.
- [createAuthlessClient](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/oauth/create-authless-client.md): Create a token provider that always returns the public token, for Foundry resources that need no sign-in.

### @osdk/aip-core

- [foundryModel](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/aip-core/foundry-model.md): Create a language model handle backed by the Foundry Language Model Service for generateText, streamText, and LmsChatTransport.
- [generateText](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/aip-core/generate-text.md): Generate a complete text response from a Foundry language model in one request.
- [streamText](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/aip-core/stream-text.md): Stream a text response from a Foundry language model as it is generated.
- [LmsChatTransport](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/aip-core/lms-chat-transport.md): A ChatTransport that streams chat replies from the Foundry Language Model Service as UI message chunks.
- [Utilities](https://older.zaini.me/osdk-ts/reference/aip-core/utilities.md): generateMessageId and getUIMessageText, helpers for working with UIMessage conversations in @osdk/aip-core.
